author: proetkhan
quote: They only get 1 point for realism and 1 point for making the game. Everything else ****. Why are we forced into 1 game mission beginning. I don't even like the main missions and stories. The game is just so bad. They claim it's realistic. No this is not realistic. All npcs feel like from Idiocracy movie. They force you to get same final result in every single mission. No really different paths to play the main game however you want. No actual freedom. Consequences are every where. I am tired of changing clothes and hair cut every single time I go explore the actual game doing what we are supposed to do. Omg this stuff at some point get too repetitive. Why isn't their an option to toggle it off. I am done. This doesn't deserve 100$ for potato fps. But since everyone is giving the game 10/10. I want to say I finished the game. And will give it 0/10 because we gotta balance out the scale. Since the game is 2/10 at best. Everyone saying it's 10/10 didn't even finish the game. But thinking again about how over hyped it was and how frustrated I was playing it .. yeah. I would remove the 2 points for my sanity.
